overall_goal: Prepare the carbonara mixture by cracking and separating eggs, grating cheese, and mixing them together

goals.description: Retrieve eggs and crack the first batch into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person gets the eggs from the fridge, sets up a bowl, and cracks the first two eggs into it, removing any shell fragments.

goals.description: Separate additional eggs to add more yolks to the mixture
goals.rationale: The person gets a second bowl to separate the egg whites from the yolks, adding extra yolks and one whole egg to the main mixing bowl.

goals.description: Retrieve the cheese and search for a grater
goals.rationale: The person takes the cheese out of the fridge, removes its packaging, and looks through a drawer for a fine cheese grater.

goals.description: Grate the cheese into the egg mixture
goals.rationale: The person uses the grater to shred a large amount of cheese directly into the bowl containing the eggs and yolks.

goals.description: Mix the ingredients and add final grated cheese
goals.rationale: The person mixes the eggs and cheese together with a fork, then grates a bit more cheese into the bowl to finish the mixture.
